name: Vital Farms - Egg Central Station
old_description: We do everything we can to improve the lives of people, animals, and the planet through food. By empowering family farms, putting animal welfare first, and raising the bar on what’s sold in grocery stores, we’re proving a better food system is possible.
about:
Vital Farms operates Egg Central Station, its egg washing, packing, and shipping facility, in Springfield, Missouri. The company was founded in 2007 with a mission to put animal welfare first, scale family farms, and raise food quality simultaneously — a model the industry initially deemed impossible. The business began as a pasture-raised egg brand built on a network of family farms across the Pasture Belt.

At Egg Central Station, eggs from over 600 family farms are washed, graded, packed, and shipped to more than 24,000 retailers nationwide. The facility processes several product lines including pasture-raised eggs, organic pasture-raised eggs, restorative eggs, True Blues eggs, hard-boiled eggs, and liquid whole eggs. The company rotates more than 39,000 acres of pasture annually and reports that 59% of its farmer partners use regenerative agriculture practices.

Vital Farms sells primarily to grocery retailers across the United States, distributing its branded egg products through a national network. Its customers include conventional and natural grocery chains, and the company also reaches consumers directly through its store locator and digital farm tours. The business serves the food retail and consumer packaged goods sectors.

The company is a certified B Corporation and operates under a stakeholder model rooted in Conscious Capitalism, legally requiring consideration of farmers, hens, crew members, stockholders, the environment, community, vendors, and consumers. Vital Farms also holds Certified Humane certification for its animal welfare standards. Its stated purpose is to improve the lives of people, animals, and the planet through food.
